## What's new in 1.2.0

### Updates inside the app — always your choice
- **About & updates** in Settings shows your version, build date and update channel, with **Check now**,
  **What's new** (the release notes, right in the app) and **Update now**.
- On the first start RambiBox **asks once** whether it may check GitHub for new versions once a day. Until you answer,
  it doesn't contact GitHub on its own; you can change your answer any time in Settings.
- When a new version is out you get a note on Home (and one tray notification per version) with
  **What's new**, **Update now** and **Skip this version**.
- **Update now** downloads the new `RambiBox.exe`, checks its **digital signature**, swaps it in and restarts —
  your lights go dark for a few seconds and come back on the new version.
- **Install updates automatically** is **off by default**. Turn it on and new versions are installed while you're not
  using the PC (10 minutes without keyboard/mouse, or the display is off) — never during a calibration or while an
  integration controls the LEDs. You get a notification afterwards.
- **Update channel:** *Stable* (releases only) or *Beta* (also pre-releases).
- Tray menu: **Check for updates…**

### Safe by design
- Every release is signed (ECDSA P-256). An update whose signature doesn't verify against the key built into
  RambiBox is **never installed** — you'll see "The download could not be verified" instead.
- The new version must report a healthy start within 45 seconds. If it doesn't, RambiBox puts the previous version
  back, starts it again and tells you ("Update failed — you're still on …"). That version is not retried
  automatically.
- Privacy: the check is one standard HTTPS request to `api.github.com` (plus the download from GitHub when you update).
  Nothing about you or your PC is sent.

### Good to know
- 1.1.0 and older can't update themselves: install 1.2.0 once by hand (download `RambiBox.exe` and replace the old
  one, or run `install.cmd`). From 1.2.0 on, updates are one click.
- Updating needs the release `RambiBox.exe` in a folder you can write to (like `%LocalAppData%\Programs\RambiBox`).
  Development builds and `--simulate`/`--demo` runs only check.
